df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')

cur = sub[sub.date==anom]
m = prev_day.merge(cur, on=['cloud_service','application','instance_family'], suffixes=('_p','_c'))

print("max price change:", m.dprice.abs().max())
